session_read: Relief rally, not resolution. SMH +6.91% intraday on three stacked tailwinds -- Microsoft's Azure beat rebutting the AI-capex-financing fear, a steady Fed unwinding the VIX spike (20.66->18.23), and sell-side (Jefferies/Bernstein/UBS) walking back CXMT as a near-term threat -- reversed a three-session, VIX-spiking memory selloff that had already triggered two stop-outs this cycle. But smith-thesis is explicit: no new information resolves the underlying CXMT/China-DRAM threat, so ASML/MU/SNDK stay WATCH, not upgraded -- this is a beta bounce the book is riding, not a thesis vindication. AI Memory/Storage remains the book's largest cluster breach at 24.9% (cap 20%) even after today's move, which argues for trimming into strength rather than chasing it; Compute/Hyperscaler is the mirror-image gap at 10.0% (floor 15%), and GOOGL -- its natural fill -- is one of only two red names in the book today, but smith-catalyst reads that as rotation/catch-down from its 07-23 capex print, not a fresh miss. QCOM is the other red name and it is genuinely idiosyncratic: a fresh FQ3 guidance cut explicitly blaming rising memory costs, meaning QCOM is short the same rally lifting MU/SNDK/DRAM elsewhere in this same book. BE/GLW/MKSI -- last night's three unclassified re-entries -- got their first full thesis and cluster reads this run and all posted STRONG UPTREND + MOMENTUM+VOLUME days.
